about.heading: A local salon for hair, beauty and a little time for yourself.
about.lead: Finishing Touch brings hair, beauty, nail and tanning services together on Bidford High Street.
about.summary: Whether you're booking a fresh cut, a beauty treatment, a nail appointment or a tanning session, the salon offers an easy local place to get ready and feel your best.
paragraphs: Based at 82 High Street in Bidford-on-Avon, Finishing Touch is a local hair and beauty salon offering a broad mix of personal-care services.
The salon combines hairdressing, beauty treatments, nail services and tanning under one roof, making it easy to arrange more than one part of your routine in the same local setting.
For current availability or to discuss the right appointment, call the salon directly.
